description_en: Deletes server groups from a Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance
description_zh: 从网络型负载均衡服务器组中移除后端服务器
kebab_example: aliyun nlb remove-servers-from-server-group --server-group-id sgp-atstuj3rtoptyui0000 --servers ServerType=Ecs ServerId=i-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 ServerIp=192.168.6.6 Port=443 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: RemoveServersFromServerGroup

fields.help_en: The port that is used by the backend server. Valid values: 0 to 65535. If you do not set this parameter, the default value 0 is used
fields.help_zh: 后端服务器使用的端口。端口范围0~65535，不填则默认传入端口值0
fields.name: port

fields.help_en:
The backend server ID.

If the server group is of the Instance type, set this parameter to the IDs of servers of the Ecs, Eni, or Eci type.
If the server group is of the Ip type, set ServerId to IP addresses
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器ID。

当服务器组为Instance类型时，该参数为Ecs、Eni、Eci的资源ID。

当服务器组为Ip类型时，该参数为IP地址
fields.name: server_id

fields.help_en: The IP addresses of the server. If the server group type is Ip, set the ServerId parameter to IP addresses
fields.help_zh: 服务器IP地址。当服务器组为Ip类型时，必须指定IP地址
fields.name: server_ip

fields.help_en:
The type of the backend server. Valid values:

Ecs: the Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance
Eni: the elastic network interface (ENI)
Eci: the elastic container instance
Ip: the IP address
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器类型，取值：

Ecs：ECS实例。
Eni：ENI弹性网卡实例。
Eci：ECI弹性容器。
Ip：Ip地址
fields.name: server_type

parameters.help_en: The backend servers. You can specify up to 200 backend servers in each call
parameters.help_zh: 后端服务器列表，单次调用最多支持传入200个服务器
parameters.name: servers

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: validates the request without performing the operation. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the validation, the corresponding error message is returned. If the request passes the validation, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): validates the request and performs the operation. If the request passes the validation, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会移除服务器。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token. Ensure that the token is unique among different requests. Only ASCII characters are allowed.

If you do not set this parameter, the value of RequestId is used.**** The value of RequestId is different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the NLB instance is deployed.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡实例所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

schema.description_en: Removes backend servers from a server group

JobId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous task
